{"nodes":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"8d568507c4ffa30bcd31734794c40555","modified":1612428976224,"text":"梵语:阿毗达磨够卡嘎热嘎"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3d202fc3b4e54be532091448359a552b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"藏语:秋温波奏戒策累俄雪巴"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"38bd9d236d3d257b1743bd11245ac1e1","modified":1612428976224,"text":"汉意:对法藏颂"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":2,"id":"2ef29e61f40f956d77d4f6225a0560f6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、译名"},{"color":"#3da8f5","heading":2,"id":"18013f72da21b607ef9af3db23c765b2","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、解释论名"},{"color":"#3da8f5","heading":2,"id":"763d1b797486682be9d0df5d2b960b74","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、不同译名之必要"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":1,"id":"0f72e1bda9e9d4d62a782ad0650e5a91","modified":1612428976224,"text":"一、论名之义"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"171b59dcfc42ea89cc45a60ba6ee36e2","modified":1612428976224,"text":"顶礼文殊童子！"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":1,"id":"c216ad49d5a5cf7c270e268cfb45230e","modified":1612428976224,"text":"二、译礼"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2e14220c7e664b1a5151aa4e25227a67","modified":1612428976224,"text":"何者尽毁一切暗，引众脱离轮回泥，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"985b62d25f87769b7d2a480319bd63af","modified":1612428976224,"text":"顶礼如理说法佛，对法藏论此详说。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#333333","heading":3,"id":"396ee079d00fecc7f34b7245166e5eb5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、礼赞与立誓"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"286799aa8cdef22c4a4283f7d98ff3d6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"净慧随行为对法，为得彼之诸慧论，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"f60c690ffcbc3676a324250e3154f084","modified":1612428976224,"text":"对法之义纳此中，或此所依故为藏。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#333333","heading":3,"id":"3b9f660b245a348e281cb975d6b4a21b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、解说论名"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"91f00b97cbc08f15b8048769c444b460","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无辨诸法之智慧，无法息灭诸烦恼，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"0c667f77faa6a7f70a3365249a25bb18","modified":1612428976224,"text":"以惑漂泊有海故，传闻此论乃佛说。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#333333","heading":3,"id":"0df3fdcf181c570bb774651029b0ca88","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、此论以必要等四法成立佛说"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":2,"id":"23543e9a34d708031e151b9f7a91e84a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、入造论支分"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"bff248f3ccb9f2ed0e6f57c4f64a25e5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有漏无漏一切法，除道谛外有为法，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"08184612ff56f45007391a492d9096a6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"皆增一切有漏惑，是故称之为有漏；"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"92fbc10c5a9f66ae538ac1f82d796fc6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"虚空二灭三无为，以及道谛为无漏。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":3,"id":"ac091bf90fd45ae5c7145c92576b7264","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、明确内容"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"b6fc8d62127c5d3ec568f4e3317a6389","modified":1612428976224,"text":"其中虚空即无碍，择灭离系各异体，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c59cec0c31d8ecfbb2c608555af535e4","modified":1612428976224,"text":"抉择灭外非择灭，永远制止未生法。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"1711094a3ad28052dac20290f7baa3bf","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、广说无为法"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#ffaf38","id":"044ab751bdf95a1462bca34a7e84fbb0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、八品之理"},{"color":"#ffaf38","id":"5d7577143ea5984dfd7d782340418bf5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、八品之联系"},{"color":"#ffaf38","id":"86aeb61b333a35e95db222a141cb100a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、各品所说之内容"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"c9f84a5546a249a5de66cd2d71c41028","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、总义"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"6e7f4e7275ba7ae1cf0b78fcefa11734","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所有一切有为法，亦分色等之五蕴。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"9e99a46cd002546bb729fdd03f6eadab","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、有为法"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"b4df3396a87a864a7be38e46a0b088d3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼等亦称时言依，以及出离与有基。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":3,"id":"3c9c669bb94c6994bcdda9ca3da5feb6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、有为法之别名"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2723d8d40457c184ff81805e64504b5c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"如是有漏法亦称，近取之蕴及有诤，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"816ee52dca6dec273b661092d44dc1ff","modified":1612428976224,"text":"痛苦及集与世间，见处以及三有也。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":3,"id":"ec89b59cdd5b2bda488b06b856032d19","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、有漏法之别名"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":2,"id":"4947853341a9be1f252bee85280e3f91","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、别名"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"02198e2b5eecf87cabbb3d00350e4a86","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所谓之色即五根，五境以及无表色。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","id":"b22e55193877f405ee591153d23f940f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"a9675b973e0f252c92ec88e7fe7192f0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼等均是识所依，眼等诸根清净色。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"ba1ff85d08e383f44e4b5ecd39c129f6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、以法相之方式宣说五根"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"63d030a952f6609b2eb4edcfc4c76dd9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"色有二种或二十，所谓之声有八种，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"4603fd7b7d17a9de8fc9d710c7b9a012","modified":1612428976224,"text":"味有六种香分四，所触分为十一种。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"cbac7edd00c0dd35498f1a2e5e704573","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、以事相之方式宣说五境"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2cec3a2a0c60d90c4b1bb2396d675c9b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"散乱以及无心时，善不善法及随流，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"690bcfe57c8d7b96d2dd0bbce4a27fe0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"一切大种作为因，彼即称为无表色。"},{"id":"50322b57429a1f650a7adde7430a788f","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"9a198a2c309679131558c22d308f7093","modified":1612428976224,"text":"大种地水火与风，成立执持等作用，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"64efa8a7c70991917dcefcfbd8de34c7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"特性硬湿暖动摇，世间界之名言中，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"e1dcae954d9b2f39d2256eea7ecf4af6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"显色形色称为地，水火与风亦复然。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"c0109da009554c9580de7e4bc587faa6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、宣说无表色"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","id":"aa3cdf2d69aa4e0f66fcc72a0ef23548","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"a5c06d7d576de6abc9394e3c9ab49524","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、真实宣说色蕴"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c42f2c9fd0919ef2aa91836882d6eed3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"承许五根与五境，唯是十处与十界。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"05004839d38de7c07b801e7ccc93e06b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、根境与界处之关联"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#333333","id":"3149e768c5465e51cc9efc2089fb8f5a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、色蕴之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"69aa03d43679b90ad6448fa5c9413b00","modified":1612428976224,"text":"受蕴即为亲感觉，想乃执相之自性。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"923fc841a2a2f2934c5cffdb160b7a5c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"行四蕴外有为法，彼三以及无表色，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"fc2d9c52f97553692f2065304720184a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"加上一切无为法，即是所谓法处界。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"4b206eacbfe08795d37bb4b55eaa6dc6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、中间三蕴之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"1b3714337b3903215092797cee310dae","modified":1612428976224,"text":"识蕴分别而认知，意处亦属识蕴中，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"ddb6e41f6e1e0166a15d0e8d31408570","modified":1612428976224,"text":"亦承许彼为七界，因有六识以及意。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c4f2bdb3ded26877353b4677a685f8e8","modified":1612428976224,"text":"六种识聚已灭尽，无间之识即是意。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"96666c0073b9a8f8c612c96478d51d88","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、识蕴之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3039241a9fd812761c756857a9a627a1","modified":1612428976224,"text":"为立第六识所依，承许界有十八种，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"dc6212d4f3ed4b39245ca7a183fe26a7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"一蕴一界与一处，可以包括一切法。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"f167fd103c709f581581f7dbfcf75b35","modified":1612428976224,"text":"即以自之本体摄，不具其他实法故。"},{"id":"3f398a3f4cd77ea8e8cf888d68adadec","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"576c4ecfaa4c8f8acddac73a7d90aaca","modified":1612428976224,"text":"眼等根虽有二数，然类行境与心识，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"7d9443f2b3091d4c26628d5c6505d6c1","modified":1612428976224,"text":"皆相同故为一界，为显端严而生二。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"f93d4b60a33223874cbc009c59dc7cc5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、遣除实法之疑虑"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"67cb5757c3a6444efda6470493e959a6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、真实宣说蕴界处"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"badb9ef5bedc75472542c8ae6f23a781","modified":1612428976224,"text":"积聚生门种类义，即是一切蕴处界。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2621ff4423b425d2bce261767bdadb88","modified":1612428976224,"text":"为断三痴依三根，三意乐说蕴处界。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"898f21a2116fa7ef8f38ff913386d253","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、蕴界处各自含义及必要性"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"cbfe05a32c97eab60ed225083d7a84d8","modified":1612428976224,"text":"成为争论之根源，轮回之因次第因，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"bf3465445c269300ab44e90b3cbb1338","modified":1612428976224,"text":"是故一切心所中，受想单独立为蕴。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"f29f50214a1b79dfcb8aed3ea1fbc71d","modified":1612428976224,"text":"蕴中不摄无为法，义不相应故未说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"014156bae8ed710ed95c62eb56375c2c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、单独安立受想蕴之理由"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"d8fd4ac655111fb75181df2414024e6f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"次第随粗诸烦恼，器等义界如是立。"},{"id":"fe6fd97a1a0dec8a77e9a8000e8e1ff8","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"f052f36f8dedead876814ed55e0019e3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"取现境故先五根，取大所生故四根，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"1087a0bf5eedd5c67fce12d3bd55ebf9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"他中最远速执故，或依位置之次第。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"92555a9c6a91515889cc6849a659c2a7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、蕴界处次第确定之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"20236cbcffcb3ceacaddeb704b8ddd19","modified":1612428976224,"text":"为分别境与主要，故唯眼境称色处。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c49760a792f979f0bd3b67f97583a434","modified":1612428976224,"text":"为摄众多殊胜法，故唯意境名为法。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"2393bb11ba5d910ac8c8faa12294a16f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"5、二处决定之理"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":3,"id":"570f6095903d70216e820e28abbf3584","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、蕴界处之自性"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"1c149cfef04f645d03e0da813991cb31","modified":1612428976224,"text":"能仁佛陀所宣说，所有八万诸法蕴，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c1e98785848874f58f55fc39256242bf","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无论词句或名称，均可摄于色行中。"},{"id":"f87167c6017d8f5eb92d29b4405adcd2","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"a5f08f371bb8d2bf1b15bdd2e8cea1b9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有者称谓一论量，尽说蕴等每一句，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"9b7c99403a424074681bce2c978b1c9d","modified":1612428976224,"text":"身语意行之对治，相应宣说诸法蕴，"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"5041cbe706e41220089c01e044e2a0a8","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、摄法蕴之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"298f21666ca74a5fa68cdb7c389149e6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"如是此外如所应，所有一切蕴界处，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"159d21cf8bdb12ca9e8624b24024dedc","modified":1612428976224,"text":"详察细究自法相，应当摄于前述中。"},{"id":"92c0255e8d4b01ac9e1d0737837ab01d","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"ae43ec9f506351d502718e60a55b727a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"孔隙称为虚空界，传说即是明与暗，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"5b8cac4de10261c977bf38aa5b4ecfed","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所谓有漏之识者，即是识界生所依。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"e8a77131ffbace4d9dcdcd614a9129b9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、其他依此类推"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":3,"id":"fa6319565ae031b4e8cf1d0f5d3203e8","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、摄他法之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"837cdbad3a69faab1c0a84d709a78dc5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有见即是唯一色，有对乃为十色界，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3e1a269ce78d0acec395e0bd5285c877","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无记之法有八种，除色声外余三种。"},{"id":"b74dac8459e0fa92cea7f6570bd1a025","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"57f8b723bdaef58736f18f575246b934","modified":1612428976224,"text":"欲界具有十八界，色界之中十四界，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"4586a5ded7b6430f685499bfa0b01bbd","modified":1612428976224,"text":"香味以及鼻舌识，此四种界未所属。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"809bdcf1477d56cec67fe204f0a50a7b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无色界中则具有，意法以及意识界。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"6dea9a1ab7a60a263127f1da3690b376","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼三有漏与无漏，其余诸界为有漏。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"cdd8df82cf8794077cc96797d12af364","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、有见等五类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"ca4e04d394b27b16e760c5cf4ed694ce","modified":1612428976224,"text":"寻伺二者均有者，即是五种识界也。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"110cd3209b5f9a4a656b431045b6868f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"最后三界有三种，其余诸界无寻伺。"},{"id":"92b42b8fc0f028d966b5ea83834da37d","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"484257e17269dae2990f5ccf81097670","modified":1612428976224,"text":"五种根识无计度，以及随念分别念，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"7ab599a672655dc39825d7a86a880895","modified":1612428976224,"text":"计度外散意智慧，随念一切意回忆。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"5d90dbffb44e2494d26725b9afaebd61","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、有寻有伺等分类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"4dfc7a82dc1ec31f3b88cf447d56b1dd","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有缘即是七心界，以及法界之一半，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"8eb0b07031143aa75e49934fa7c95a0a","modified":1612428976224,"text":"九无执受八与声，其余九界有二种；"},{"id":"ea6594aee5c1a4d34d91847bfbdb5d08","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"fc9272b18f177d1f1d1d4ccfce5431ec","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所触大种大所造，剩余九种色法界，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"bb78307866d3fc9196627c0100277259","modified":1612428976224,"text":"大种所造无表色，十种色界即积聚。"},{"id":"5013e8850a1222d945befaeb7ce0d881","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2dd5da93aa28b2d95b8c69a9bd4d2d96","modified":1612428976224,"text":"能断以及所断者，即是外之四种界，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"e4b14f2f9ea36a073274fd07bbf54570","modified":1612428976224,"text":"如是所焚与能称，能烧所称说不同。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"c6a20f9b57e4f45a79fdd8ef593ce28c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、有缘等五类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"9f39750acb6d60d57f85af84e43f28e0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"异熟生与长养生，即是内在之五根，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"ad30a072af4c333d3c3347b2f16917ca","modified":1612428976224,"text":"声者非为异熟生，等流生及异熟生，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"58c06fb0ca89962b5d5d613d63cc12e2","modified":1612428976224,"text":"即是八种无碍法，其余则有三种生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"3e185496449fae8626b0e688e4ae9ef6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、三生之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"1603658acd96a7b3d90fe2bab916b48e","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具有实法唯一界，最后三界刹那性，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3326cd070647eca34ec3344182ff6ddc","modified":1612428976224,"text":"眼与眼识界各自，一同之中亦获得。"},{"id":"5d9146a0033c1c1e2225e083089da5c7","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"37d4f24a9082cc747adec994428d3a5d","modified":1612428976224,"text":"内在十二除色等，所谓法界为有依，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"16482d389edde72783accbfa53a59c75","modified":1612428976224,"text":"余者相应亦有依，不做与做自之事。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"17e5e6dcc7ff49ac79ad068484e1649e","modified":1612428976224,"text":"5、具实法等五类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2d00ab9c24493f20edb23a90a38bc9e7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"十色五识修所断，最后三界具三种，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3a9245a7cb3e877489452ba08f87e9d4","modified":1612428976224,"text":"非烦恼性非见断，乃色非六非为生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"686e2c8b18ced61cfdb0b478c510c88f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"6、见断等分类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"0b8a72713b93c1b870dc901d49baaaf0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"眼与法界一部分，即是正见有八种，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"a03453c2f6a98bdeb3c5c5c59b3854da","modified":1612428976224,"text":"五识相应所生慧，无计度故非为见。"},{"id":"27cf9556841bd643a1c1e74caa39f46e","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"93dd099a1dc80b16bd5cb00d3ccf19b0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"眼见诸色为有依，依彼之识非为见，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"e2d0e2ff5cc87c3a0953f7223a3b06b5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"传说中间阻隔色，并非能见之缘故。"},{"id":"87a6e31ae43be4e92aace1821344beda","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"90d43380a459a75f8922d102fa3afaa0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"双目均见诸色境，现见尤为明显故。"},{"id":"cfabaa688883ea1d687fbda16d735db8","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"42a3fa5e49a5f6f43de1f84bd333c6ad","modified":1612428976224,"text":"许眼意根与耳根，不接触境余三触，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"26b2641bbb5c8091ccbde825c13a3c0c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"鼻舌身根此三者，同等执著于对境。"},{"id":"15cc3347847867b4822f770a0f9c2e05","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"dc972f43d47bbdb323c62ef7ae0a981f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"意识根依为过去，五根识依为俱生。"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"6396d4f99366ba328ce72b1552206223","modified":1612428976224,"text":"成为根依变化故，所依乃为眼等根，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"32332c03bcb7b0c44d2be25d34df3419","modified":1612428976224,"text":"非为共同之缘故，依靠彼等说彼识。"},{"id":"226bab27c58d2afaa43874759b774282","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"85a5b05947ee2ff30159220446eaf3c6","modified":1612428976224,"text":"身体不具下地眼，下眼不见上地色，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"4c1608311bfd25eeb062638aef55c067","modified":1612428976224,"text":"眼识亦见诸色境，身为识色之所依。"},{"id":"1cdb17d2636d775bbe12fb891ed51da5","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"03e579ac95a6224692bc488bf23f0aae","modified":1612428976224,"text":"耳等诸根亦复然，三根均取自地境，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"0400aa456cbf1c53635a2779b7bdba17","modified":1612428976224,"text":"身识取下与自地，意识则是不一定。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"75f965582a6d69ea5d86917054bb1768","modified":1612428976224,"text":"7、见与非见之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"e566ddcc4e90ba2418df9fb1bf5ac80d","modified":1612428976224,"text":"根意二识取外五，诸无为法为常法，"},{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"c4d6b6f4bffebf89857c7f8a344f8d6b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"法界一半与所说，十二内界均为根。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":0,"id":"149b891d5d4c847c8c63d5a2087a1d7b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"8、二识等三类"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":3,"id":"9fe1198612ca863ff0aaf416c2011f2f","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、界之分类"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#797ec9","heading":2,"id":"b6ff8a4a82c614a87abc4421e09734da","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、广说蕴界处"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":1,"id":"be0d098a6e385c284745b6d81a420f27","modified":1612428976224,"text":"(一)、分别界品、"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"YeC7LZM7K2","modified":1612428976224,"text":"传说五根四功用，余四各具二功用，"},{"color":"","id":"XkkAD2zkPw","modified":1612428976224,"text":"五根八根彼一切，分具染净之功用。"},{"id":"J9nh8pOzKv","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"XhHShrEzPQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"缘自境与缘一切，起功用故立六根，"},{"color":"","id":"I6SFXkoEBl","modified":1612428976224,"text":"身体具有男女根，由此立为男女性。"},{"color":"","id":"Abu4FoUVui","modified":1612428976224,"text":"同类存在具染污，以及清净功用故，"},{"color":"","id":"ZaBvY9iFkj","modified":1612428976224,"text":"承许命根与受根，以及信等为五根。"},{"color":"","id":"3pvEc32H6v","modified":1612428976224,"text":"于获愈上涅槃等，起到功用之缘故，"},{"color":"","id":"OvJG4LMP2E","modified":1612428976224,"text":"立为未知当知根，已知根与具知根。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"frm6DbHU8d","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、根之功用"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"PiM9vtpOgT","modified":1612428976224,"text":"心之所依彼差别，留存以及增烦恼，"},{"color":"","id":"DB9Lfkb9IQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"资粮清净尽彼数，如是诸根亦复然。"},{"id":"WXBeiGtPu9","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"EOGgyVKwpd","modified":1612428976224,"text":"或漂轮回之所依，生存受用十四根，"},{"color":"","id":"HeHXMzJWzn","modified":1612428976224,"text":"如是灭尽诸轮回，诸根即是余八种。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"UhW0JKoS6n","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、根之定数"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"pYxhOI8zhQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、根之自性"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"XvAFt1Jt3W","modified":1612428976224,"text":"身非乐受即苦根，快乐感受即乐根，"},{"color":"","id":"eOlUmmG9CB","modified":1612428976224,"text":"三禅之心为乐根，余者即是意乐根，"},{"color":"","id":"HCeoM6mJ6s","modified":1612428976224,"text":"心非快乐意苦根，舍受中间无二故。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"BRvjMy8RFQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、宣说五受根"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ec9LvGAte9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"见修无学道九根，即是无漏之三根。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"N6E7DnruVw","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、宣说最后三根"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"SSsEf5fkIz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、此处所说根之本体"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"RpFb7uvkS2","modified":1612428976224,"text":"最后三根为无垢，七有色根与命根，"},{"color":"","id":"340hRU3cxz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"及苦受根即有漏，其余九根有二种。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"T1s15epnAw","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、观待助缘之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ILlbH6p3bs","modified":1612428976224,"text":"命根唯一是异熟，十二异熟非异熟，"},{"color":"","id":"jtgr3N8XK7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"除最后八意苦根，唯一意苦具异熟，"},{"color":"","id":"gkUAc6n8Wq","modified":1612428976224,"text":"意余受及信根等，十根具不具异熟。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"fHsEzllWZ9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、观待因果之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"iOfKWW4N7p","modified":1612428976224,"text":"善法八根意苦根，即有善与不善二，"},{"color":"","id":"VPmFwwI8Xb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"意余四受具三种，其余唯是无记法。"},{"id":"Qu8KD0209n","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"E1SNLA7fVF","modified":1612428976224,"text":"除无垢根属欲界，男根女根苦根外，"},{"color":"","id":"2vf4wp20Cv","modified":1612428976224,"text":"属于色界有色根，乐根亦除属无色。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"5h1nDfrjm1","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、观待本体之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"DhNskerM2v","modified":1612428976224,"text":"意三受根具三种，见修所断意苦根，"},{"color":"","id":"94O5E7XdJF","modified":1612428976224,"text":"九根修断信五根，非为所断然三非。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"I7bhNBoV4R","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、观待所断之分类"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"2ie1Jkye8p","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、根之分类"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"hO9rAwNFW5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"欲界初得二异熟，化生并非是如此，"},{"color":"","id":"RIokgwEYsd","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼得六根或七八，色界六根无色一。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Bai9PjTMYh","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、得根之理"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"bnNfp36mAW","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无色界中死亡时，命意舍根同时灭，"},{"color":"","id":"ldbVncagAF","modified":1612428976224,"text":"色界之中八根灭，欲界十根或九八，"},{"color":"","id":"XIX1gt5g3s","modified":1612428976224,"text":"次第而死四根灭，善心中亡加五根。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"oKOG4GjHs3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、舍根之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"VqCLHm5Myn","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、根之得舍"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"eGfaFP4wRk","modified":1612428976224,"text":"始终二果以九得，中二依七或八九，"},{"color":"","id":"7aImb3sEcG","modified":1612428976224,"text":"因会故说有者以，十一根得阿罗汉。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"VKSPKn75Z4","modified":1612428976224,"text":"5、沙门四果以几根而得"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"l71kgH7dVO","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具舍受命及意根，其中之一必具三，"},{"color":"","id":"7Dhn4rUjAz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具身乐根必具四，具眼等根必具五，"},{"color":"","id":"XKbZIhigg9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具意乐根亦具五，具苦受根必具七，"},{"color":"","id":"BCm6bV8oor","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具女根等必具八，已具知必具十一，"},{"color":"","id":"IF5VVuXtXO","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具有未知当知根，必定具足十三根。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"cs26HFvUxh","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、必具"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"A7IzQR4bQO","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无善之中具最少，具身受命意八根，"},{"color":"","id":"KiTtQqpULb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无色凡夫亦如是，舍受命意诸善根。"},{"id":"wQ4MI9cPb5","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"a6HB8LyOcC","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具最多根十九根，不摄一切无漏根，"},{"color":"","id":"TMbMmVyCwK","modified":1612428976224,"text":"两性具贪之圣者，不摄一性二无垢。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"FSaqB7CjUK","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、会具"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","heading":3,"id":"OD3FI6JccK","modified":1612428976224,"text":"6、具根之理"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","heading":2,"id":"GP4z1cBpPu","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、根之安立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"sf4AKxjFPC","modified":1612428976224,"text":"欲界无根无声尘，八种微尘一起生，"},{"color":"","id":"7LC3UguPXX","modified":1612428976224,"text":"具有身根九物质，具有他根十物质。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"CVXcplFKKv","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、色法产生之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ts2Fv72KYg","modified":1612428976224,"text":"心与心所定一起，有为法相或得绳。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"EJWX7o2WAi","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"yfdvsKfVSv","modified":1612428976224,"text":"五种心所之地法，彼等各不相同故。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"1oTtEklzBq","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"8z60kN53XW","modified":1612428976224,"text":"受想思欲以及触，智慧忆念与作意，"},{"color":"","id":"exd2mfHE9j","modified":1612428976224,"text":"胜解以及三摩地，此等随逐一切心。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"nxeuJxnvww","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、遍大地法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"XB9UrXWuvA","modified":1612428976224,"text":"信不放逸与轻安，舍心知惭及有愧，"},{"color":"","id":"gLCwBJ8ytY","modified":1612428976224,"text":"二种根本与无害，精进恒时随善生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Q1HQBl0BpJ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、大善地法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"640PbqrQkY","modified":1612428976224,"text":"痴逸不信怠沉掉，恒随烦恼性而生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Hzgm563cXo","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、大烦恼地法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"AaBFRBIPme","modified":1612428976224,"text":"不善地法有两种，即是无惭与无愧。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"phowU1NEFx","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、不善地法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"co2zauQKgN","modified":1612428976224,"text":"怒恨谄嫉恼覆吝，诳骄害即小烦恼。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"qqBl4kQOhZ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"5、小烦恼地法"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"amTMucJ8i5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、广述"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"PSfDj8KFqz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、类别决定之分类"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"eds1Ctrql0","modified":1612428976224,"text":"随逐欲界之善心，具有寻思伺察故，"},{"color":"","id":"FGAhNbPFw4","modified":1612428976224,"text":"共有二十二心所，有者加上后悔心。"},{"id":"fzLQ9GjuzZ","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"A9WJzWL3sl","modified":1612428976224,"text":"不善无杂二十生，具见亦有二十种，"},{"color":"","id":"T0v2MavFzr","modified":1612428976224,"text":"四烦恼与嗔怒等，后悔其一二十一。"},{"id":"oQ0752Fhec","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"C6VSKnaCBU","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有覆无记具十八，无覆则许有十二，"},{"color":"","id":"y6C8yMx3qv","modified":1612428976224,"text":"睡眠不违一切故，任何之法皆加彼。"},{"id":"U0ZxT5eWUV","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"bCSIObjtZx","modified":1612428976224,"text":"后悔睡眠诸不善，第一静虑中无有，"},{"color":"","id":"wbnJatg4pL","modified":1612428976224,"text":"殊胜正禅寻亦无，二禅以上伺亦无。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Z8i2p4XPPf","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、不定之相应"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"TkV6C9aObI","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无惭即是不恭敬，无愧则是不畏罪。"},{"color":"","id":"ku8u8Oxl7e","modified":1612428976224,"text":"喜为信心敬知惭，此二欲色界中有，"},{"color":"","id":"hvnOXUxpbO","modified":1612428976224,"text":"寻为粗大伺细微，我慢胜他之贡高，"},{"color":"","id":"IWdjQPFr79","modified":1612428976224,"text":"骄傲即是于自法，生贪之心至极点。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"uKUEo5pUEr","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、似相同之差别"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"PEAB3r6DW3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"心意与识实一体，心与心所及有依，"},{"color":"","id":"tQntT042Yl","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有缘有形与相应，相应亦有五种也。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"uYINrQahnY","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、似不同之一体"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"EqMW2eq4Uj","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、相应法产生之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"hUeE7Hb6MR","modified":1612428976224,"text":"一切不相应行者，得绳非得与同类，"},{"color":"","id":"po1MMEOyUw","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无想二定命法相，名称之聚等亦摄。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Sjrm4qWWOh","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"GRRtIVtSeQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"得有新得与具得，得绳以及非获得，"},{"color":"","id":"0fB19PqeLP","modified":1612428976224,"text":"均为自相续所摄，二种灭法亦复然。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"M46VQcVnWx","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、真实宣说得绳非得"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"CUDHPn6Fau","modified":1612428976224,"text":"法有三时得三种，善等得绳为善等，"},{"color":"","id":"1IxmSX0gm9","modified":1612428976224,"text":"摄彼得绳属彼界，不属三界有四法。"},{"id":"VnU7AXgAhm","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"XnDbNWUKwP","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有学无学非三种，所断非断许二种，"},{"color":"","id":"MSRzs2ymgb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无记得绳一起生，不摄神通与幻变，"},{"color":"","id":"GYtBddBQtP","modified":1612428976224,"text":"有覆色法亦如是，欲界色前无有生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"yBzEr52ekw","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、得绳之特法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"WWFN0m5DmW","modified":1612428976224,"text":"非得无覆无记法，过去未来均三种，"},{"color":"","id":"AEoz1elyBZ","modified":1612428976224,"text":"非得摄于欲界等，无垢非得亦复然，"},{"color":"","id":"fs10VbIw6b","modified":1612428976224,"text":"圣道非得许凡夫，得彼移地将退失。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"K9Q0Gbf8Gx","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、非得之特法"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1W9JPfzr4t","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、宣说彼之特法"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"tgge8NQ2LD","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、得绳非得"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"rONxDWgWVz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所谓同类不相应，即指众生皆相同。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"g3g2ewNFHW","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、同类"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"8E71S4wpd7","modified":1612428976224,"text":"无想天灭心心所，彼之异熟广果天。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"AJoGOHEBEr","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、无想"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"fGS5O1j2ox","modified":1612428976224,"text":"如是所谓无想定，欲依四禅而出离，"},{"color":"","id":"qqhQCFvIz5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"故善顺次生受业，非为圣者同时得。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"FpuLCRw1vk","modified":1612428976224,"text":"1、无想定"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"NhR1ZG1SG5","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所谓灭定亦复然，现法乐住转有顶，"},{"color":"","id":"2vC4dscEt3","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼善二种生受业，以及不定之受业。"},{"id":"e2FQyAFIjQ","modified":1612428976224,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"1EUp2xIl5c","modified":1612428976224,"text":"圣者依靠勤作得，佛以菩提而获得，"},{"color":"","id":"7wzELhNHS4","modified":1612428976224,"text":"非如初者所承许，因以卅四刹那得。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ZC64eTH8Cm","modified":1612428976224,"text":"2、灭尽定"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"68SuJL6iDz","modified":1612428976224,"text":"此二依欲色界身，灭定最初为人中。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"gmTXQEj7dK","modified":1612428976224,"text":"3、此二共同之所依"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"dSPYC6olEb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"4、二定"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"3vPLWZqu23","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所谓命不相应行，即寿温识之所依。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ghvDNraFjN","modified":1612428976224,"text":"5、命"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"rXtgZes4kb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"所有法相不相应，即是生衰住与灭，"},{"color":"","id":"JEMwn85Mtb","modified":1612428976224,"text":"彼等具生之
